# Numbered Steps

`features/numbered-steps` &middot; section-level &middot; category: features

## Purpose

A numbered sequence of steps, as vertical rows or a horizontal row, with number markers.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | features |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Vertical rows with plain accent numbers (01, 02, 03).
- **circles**: Vertical rows with numbers in filled circles. Sets `shape: circle`, `numbering: plain`.
- **horizontal**: Steps side by side with the number above each. Sets `layout: horizontal`, `shape: centered`.
- **horizontal-circles**: Steps side by side with numbers in circles. Sets `layout: horizontal`, `shape: circle`, `numbering: plain`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `layout` | one of `vertical`, `horizontal` | `"vertical"` |
| `numbering` | one of `zero`, `plain` | `"zero"` |
| `shape` | one of `default`, `circle`, `outline`, `centered` | `"default"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Number markers are table cells, honored. Circles render as squares. | Fine. Horizontal steps stack on phones through a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('features/numbered-steps', {
  "heading": "How it works",
  "intro": "Three simple steps to your first box.",
  "steps": [
    {
      "title": "Choose your plan",
      "description": "Pick the box size that fits your household."
    },
    {
      "title": "Customize your experience",
      "description": "Tell us what you like and what to leave out."
    },
    {
      "title": "Start enjoying the benefits",
      "description": "Your first box ships within two working days."
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "Get started",
    "href": "https://example.com/start"
  }
}) ]]
```
